android.description: How EmuLabZip connects to Android emulators and USB or wireless devices with its built-in ADB client, what it collects and what each device state means.

app-state.description: Save everything an app keeps (databases, preferences, files) into one .ezstate file, restore it later, and compare two states to see what changed.

budgets.description: Set limits for CPU, memory, start time, size and crashes in one config file, and make emulabzip ci fail a run when it costs more than the baseline.

distribution.description: How EmuLabZip releases are built by GitHub Actions from a version tag, what each release attaches (installers, SHA256SUMS), code signing and in-app updates.

getting-started.description: Install EmuLabZip, connect your first Android emulator or iOS simulator and read your app's logs in a couple of minutes, in the desktop app or the CLI.

mcp-tools.description: Every tool, prompt and resource of the EmuLabZip MCP server for AI assistants, by area, with its arguments and whether it reads, changes or asks first.

network-rules.description: Map requests to local files or other servers, check responses against an OpenAPI contract, run sandboxed WebAssembly scripts and chain rules in EmuLabZip.

react-native-state.description: Read the live state of a React Native development app from EmuLabZip: Redux, React Query, React context and registered stores, in the app or the CLI.

roadmap.description: What EmuLabZip has shipped, phase by phase, and what is planned next: devices and platforms, team features and the 1.0 promise of stable interfaces.

troubleshooting.description: Fixes for the usual problems: a device that does not show up, a log that is too busy, apps that cannot be read, a proxy that does not decrypt HTTPS.

devices.description: Create, start, stop, wipe and delete Android emulators and iOS simulators from EmuLabZip, and keep emulator snapshots, in the Devices view or the CLI.

how-the-official-tools-work.description: What we learned about how Xcode Instruments and the Android Studio profilers collect their data, and which of those public interfaces EmuLabZip uses.

ci.description: Record a session around any command, usually your test run, with emulabzip ci: it keeps the exit code, saves a session file and can fail on regressions.

customizing.description: Resize panes, collapse and reorder the sidebar, and tune text size, density and scale in EmuLabZip's Settings so the app fits how you work.
